categories.other_revenue: Broaden the base and other revenue

provisions.label: Reduce the annual COLA by 0.5 percentage point
provisions.description: Starting December 2027, reduce the annual COLA by 0.5 percentage point

provisions.label: Use the chained CPI-W for the COLA
provisions.description: Starting December 2027, compute the COLA using a chained version of the CPI-W (about 0.3 percentage point lower on average)

provisions.label: Use the CPI-E (elderly) for the COLA
provisions.description: Starting December 2028, compute the COLA using the CPI for the Elderly (CPI-E)

provisions.label: Progressive price indexing above the 30th percentile
provisions.description: Progressive price indexing of PIA factors above the 30th-percentile AIME, for those newly eligible in 2033 and later

provisions.label: Progressive price indexing above the 50th percentile
provisions.description: Progressive price indexing of PIA factors above the 50th-percentile AIME, for those newly eligible in 2033 and later

provisions.label: Index initial benefits to life expectancy
provisions.description: For those newly eligible for OASI in 2036 and later, scale PIA factors by the ratio of life expectancy at 67 (longevity indexing of initial benefits)

provisions.label: Base benefits on 40 years of earnings instead of 35
provisions.description: Increase the number of computation years for retired workers and survivors from 35 to 40, phased in over 2027-2035

provisions.label: Cut benefits 5% for new beneficiaries from 2027
provisions.description: Reduce benefits by 5 percent for those newly eligible for benefits in 2027 and later

provisions.label: Raise benefits 5% for all beneficiaries from 2027
provisions.description: Increase benefits by 5 percent for all beneficiaries as of the beginning of 2027 and for those newly eligible thereafter

provisions.label: Enhanced minimum benefit at 125% of poverty
provisions.description: Reconfigure the special minimum benefit for those newly eligible in 2027 and later: PIA for 30 years of coverage set at 125 percent of the monthly poverty level, wage-indexed for later cohorts

provisions.label: Raise benefits 5% at age 85
provisions.description: Increase benefits by 5 percent for beneficiaries age 85 or older, starting in 2027

provisions.label: Raise the retirement age to 68 by 1 month every 2 years
provisions.description: Starting with those age 62 in 2027, raise the normal retirement age 1 month every 2 years until it reaches 68

provisions.label: Raise the retirement age to 68 by 2 months a year
provisions.description: Raise the normal retirement age 2 months per year for those age 62 in 2027 through 2032, reaching 68

provisions.label: Index the retirement age to longevity
provisions.description: Starting with those age 62 in 2027, index the normal retirement age to keep expected retirement years a constant share of potential work years (roughly 1 month every 2 years)

provisions.label: Raise the retirement age to 69, then index it
provisions.description: Raise the normal retirement age 2 months per year for those age 62 in 2027 through 2038 (reaching 69), then 1 month every 2 years

provisions.label: Raise the payroll tax rate to 13.0% (2029-2034)
provisions.description: Raise the payroll tax rate 0.1 percentage point per year from 2029 through 2034, reaching 13.0 percent

provisions.label: Raise the payroll tax rate to 13.4% (2028-2037)
provisions.description: Raise the payroll tax rate 0.1 percentage point per year from 2028 through 2037, reaching 13.4 percent

provisions.label: Raise the payroll tax rate to 14.4% (2032-2051)
provisions.description: Raise the payroll tax rate 0.1 percentage point per year from 2032 through 2051, reaching 14.4 percent

provisions.label: Eliminate the taxable maximum (no benefit credit)
provisions.description: Eliminate the taxable maximum in years 2027 and later, and apply full 12.4 percent payroll tax rate to all earnings (no benefit credit for earnings above the current-law taxable maximum)

provisions.label: Eliminate the taxable maximum (with benefit credit)
provisions.description: Eliminate the taxable maximum in 2027 and later, apply 12.4 percent to all earnings, and give benefit credit for earnings above the current-law taxable maximum

provisions.label: Tax earnings above $250,000 (no benefit credit)
provisions.description: Apply the 12.4 percent payroll tax rate to earnings above $250,000 starting in 2027 (all earnings once the taxable maximum exceeds $250,000), with no benefit credit for the additional earnings taxed

provisions.label: Tax earnings above $400,000 (no benefit credit)
provisions.description: Apply the 12.4 percent payroll tax rate to earnings above $400,000 starting in 2027 (all earnings once the taxable maximum exceeds $400,000), with no benefit credit for the additional earnings taxed

provisions.label: Cover 90% of earnings (with benefit credit)
provisions.description: Raise the taxable maximum so that 90 percent of earnings are taxable, phased in 2027-2036, with benefit credit for earnings up to the new maximum

provisions.label: Cover 90% of earnings (no benefit credit)
provisions.description: Raise the taxable maximum so that 90 percent of earnings are taxable, phased in 2027-2036, with no benefit credit for the additional earnings taxed

provisions.label: Cover newly hired state and local workers
provisions.description: Starting in 2027, cover newly hired State and local government employees

provisions.label: Phase out the payroll tax exclusion for employer health premiums
provisions.description: Starting in 2030, phase out the OASDI payroll tax exclusion for employer-sponsored group health insurance premiums, reaching full taxation in 2040

provisions.label: Apply payroll tax to cafeteria-plan contributions
provisions.description: Starting in 2027, subject contributions to voluntary salary reduction plans (cafeteria plans, flexible spending accounts) to the OASDI payroll tax, as 401(k) contributions are today

provisions.label: Dedicate a 2009-level estate tax to the trust funds
provisions.description: For deaths and gifts after 2026, restore the estate, gift and GST taxes to 2009 parameters ($3.5 million exemption, 45 percent top rate, unindexed) and credit all proceeds to the OASDI trust funds

provisions.label: 12.4% tax on investment income above $200,000 / $250,000
provisions.description: Starting in 2028, a separate 12.4 percent tax on ACA-defined investment income above unindexed $200,000 (single) / $250,000 (joint) thresholds, credited to the OASDI trust funds with no benefit credit

provisions.label: Tax benefits like private pensions
provisions.description: Starting in 2027, tax Social Security benefits like private pension income, phasing out the lower-income thresholds over 2027-2046

provisions.label: Tax 100% of benefits above $250,000 / $500,000
provisions.description: Starting in 2033, make up to 100 percent of benefits taxable (the remaining 15 percent) for filers with MAGI of $250,000 or more ($500,000 joint), thresholds wage-indexed, revenue to the OASDI trust funds

provisions.label: Phase out income tax on benefits (2045-2054)
provisions.description: Phase out income taxation of OASDI benefits credited to the trust funds over 2045-2053 and eliminate it from 2054 (HI revenue unchanged)

provisions.label: Tax all benefits above $100,000 / $125,000
provisions.description: Starting in 2029, tax all Social Security benefits for beneficiaries with income above $100,000 ($125,000 joint), thresholds CPI-indexed, revenue to the OASDI trust funds
